block.guguaddons.quest_interface.tooltip: Core block of a multiblock structure used for task item submission.
A 3x3x3 solid structure with the core at the center of the front side.
Consumes 512su per 1 RPM (total depends on input interface speed).
guguaddons.ponder.quest_interface_struct: The Calculation Terminal is a 5x4x3 multiblock structure.
Start with a 5x3 base of Deduction Casings.
The structure requires at least 256 RPM to function.
You can replace any Deduction Casing with functional interfaces.
Use a Kinetic Input Interface to supply power...
...and a Submission Interface to submit items.
Note: only one of each interface type is allowed per structure.
guguaddons.ponder.vacuum_chamber.text_1: The Compressor processes the contents of a Basin placed two blocks below it
guguaddons.ponder.vacuum_chamber.text_2: It acts as a cogwheel itself and requires at least medium speed
guguaddons.ponder.vacuum_chamber.text_3: In Vacuumizing mode, it runs vacuumizing recipes on the items and fluids in the Basin
guguaddons.ponder.vacuum_chamber.text_4: Right-click it with a Wrench to switch between Vacuumizing and Pressurizing mode. Each mode only runs recipes of its own type
guguaddons.ponder.vacuum_chamber.text_5: The mode cannot be changed while it is running. Engineer's Goggles show the current mode
guguaddons.ponder.vacuum_chamber.text_6: In Pressurizing mode, it runs pressurizing recipes instead
guguaddons.ponder.vacuum_chamber.text_7: Some recipes require heat from a Blaze Burner below the Basin
guguaddons.ponder.vacuum_chamber_seconda: The Compressor has its own input tank and output tank, which pipes can access from any side
Some recipes take a specific fluid ingredient from the input tank instead of the Basin
Here, the Dirt in the Basin and the Water from the input tank are pressurized into Mud
Likewise, some recipes store a fluid product in the output tank, where it can be pumped out
Here, a Wet Sponge is vacuumized into a Sponge, and the extracted Water goes into the output tank
guguaddons.ponder.centrifuge.text_1: The Centrifuge occupies a 3x3 area. The eight surrounding blocks must be free when it is placed
guguaddons.ponder.centrifuge.text_2: Right-click it with Basins to install them. It only operates once all four Basins are installed
guguaddons.ponder.centrifuge.text_3: Power it with a vertical shaft from above. Each recipe sets a minimum speed, and higher speeds process faster
guguaddons.ponder.centrifuge.text_4: Its inventory is locked while it spins. Items and fluids can only be inserted or extracted while it is stopped, e.g. by a Clutch
guguaddons.ponder.centrifuge.text_5: While stopped, ingredients can be thrown on top, inserted by hand, or supplied through Funnels and pipes on any of its nine blocks
guguaddons.ponder.centrifuge.text_6: Processing starts once it spins again. Stopping it midway only pauses the progress
guguaddons.ponder.centrifuge.text_7: Once finished, stop it again to extract the products from any of its nine blocks
guguaddons.ponder.abyss_catalytic_chambe: The Abyss Catalytic Chamber consists of a bottom, a middle and a top tier. Placing it builds all three
A Mechanical Shrieker facing down above the chamber runs the process. It may sit directly on the top tier or one block higher
Power the Shrieker through a shaft from above. Higher speeds shorten each step
Heated recipes draw heat from a Blaze Burner below the bottom tier
Step I, Settling: starts once the bottom ingredients, heat and power are ready. It consumes the bottom ingredients and emits a vibration of frequency 4
Step II, Activation: requires a catalyst in the middle tier and pauses without one. It emits a vibration of frequency 8, and the catalyst may be consumed when it ends
Step III, Condensation: emits a vibration of frequency 14 and waits. Only now add the top ingredients; once they suffice, they are consumed and the products are made
The top tier must stay empty during Settling and Activation, or the batch turns into Sculk Dregs. The next batch may be preloaded in the bottom tier, and the middle tier may keep its catalyst
Products are stored in the bottom tier and can be extracted with Funnels or pipes. A Depot, Belt or container diagonally below receives them directly; use a Wrench to choose the side
The chamber has no comparator output. Calibrated Sculk Sensors tuned to frequencies 4, 8 and 14 tell which step is running, which allows timed automatic feeding
